propositions: when a child has zero local comments and lives in the live-search path (snapshot lacks comment field), the parent-drift breadcrumb is not emitted because _diff_comments early-returns before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached
the snapshot path successfully emits the breadcrumb even with zero local comments because it carries the comment field; the live-search path has no fallback

the fix requires extracting comment-set resolution (_snapshot_comment_set, _live_comment_set) and breadcrumb precondition logic (_breadcrumb_target) from _diff_comments and _build_parent_breadcrumb to avoid exceeding McCabe complexity limits
in the live-search path, when local_comments is empty but _breadcrumb_target indicates a drift condition, comments must be fetched from the client for the append-once dedup set
client-None and fetch-failure cases must preserve bug-4292 safety by returning no mutations rather than blind-adding with unknown comment state
